title: Laboratory profile
purpose: See the laboratory's identity as staff and clients see it: its name, address, contact details, logo and certificates, its security and privacy contacts, and which optional modules are on. The admin laboratory role changes these here.
summary: The laboratory's name, address, contact details, logo, certificates, security and privacy contacts and optional modules. The admin role changes them here; every staff role can read them.

tasks.title: Change the address or contact details
steps: Select [[Edit]], change the details and save. Staff and client portal accounts see them from then on.

tasks.title: Set the logo
steps: Select [[Upload logo]] or [[Replace logo]] and choose a PNG or JPEG file.

tasks.title: Record a certificate
steps: Select [[Add certificate]] and enter the issuing authority, the certificate or laboratory ID and any validity dates.

tasks.title: Record the security or privacy contact
steps: Under Security and privacy contacts select [[Security contact]] or [[Privacy contact]], fill in the details, give a reason and save.

tasks.title: Turn an optional module on or off
steps: Under Optional modules select [[Turn on]] or [[Turn off]] beside the module, give a reason and confirm.

good_to_know: Client portal accounts see the address, contact details and logo on their portal home. They do not see this page, the certificates or the security and privacy contacts.
Removing the logo or a certificate keeps its details in the history below.
The application checks nothing against a certificate. It lists what you recorded and makes no accreditation claim.
The laboratory name is set at installation and cannot be changed here.
Turning an optional module off hides its pages for everyone. Its records are kept and reappear when it is turned on again.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Every staff laboratory role can read this page, and the Setup menu lists it for each of them. Only the admin laboratory role sees Edit, Upload logo, Replace logo, Add certificate, the Remove buttons, the links on the security and privacy contacts, and Turn on and Turn off for optional modules, and the server refuses changes from anyone else. Client portal accounts cannot open this page.
When the laboratory has not been set up yet, the page shows No laboratory configured and offers no profile changes; the Optional modules panel still shows. Run the setup_lab command first.

items.label: Laboratory name
items.description: The name set when the application was installed. It is shown here for reference and cannot be changed on this page.

items.label: Address
items.description: Street address, suite or building, then city, state and ZIP code on one line. Not recorded when no part of the address is entered.

items.label: Phone, Email, Website
items.description: Contact details for the laboratory. Each shows Not recorded when blank.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Admin role only. Opens the form for the address and contact details.

items.label: Preview, Size and Type
items.description: The current logo, scaled down to fit, with its stored size in pixels and its file type (PNG or JPEG). With no logo, the client portal shows the laboratory name without one.

items.label: Upload logo / Replace logo
items.description: Admin role only. Opens the upload form. The new logo is shown on the profile and on the client portal home.

items.label: Remove
items.description: Admin role only, shown when there is a logo. Asks for confirmation, then the client portal shows the laboratory name without a logo. The image stays stored so the history can show it. If someone changed the profile after you opened this page, the removal is refused; reload and try again.

sections.title: Security and privacy contacts
paragraphs: The person or office your laboratory names for questions about the security of its systems, and the one it names for the privacy of patient information, as the laboratory records them. Every staff role sees them here; the admin role also sees them on Security settings. Client portal accounts do not see them. The application checks nothing against them.

items.label: Contact
items.description: Security contact or Privacy contact. For the admin role the name opens the contact's form, which needs a reason for every change; for everyone else it is plain text.

items.label: Name or office
items.description: The person or office. Not recorded when the contact has never been saved or was cleared.

items.label: Title or role, Email, Phone
items.description: As recorded, or a dash when blank. The email address opens your mail program.

sections.title: Certificates
paragraphs: The certifications and accreditations your laboratory records, in list position order, so staff can quote their identifiers to clients. The application keeps no register of what a certificate covers and checks nothing against a certificate.

items.label: Issuing authority
items.description: The body that issued the certificate. For the admin role it opens the certificate's edit form.

items.label: Program or scope
items.description: The program or scope the laboratory recorded, or a dash.

items.label: Certificate or laboratory ID
items.description: The number the authority assigned.

items.label: Valid from, Valid until
items.description: The recorded validity dates, or a dash when a date is not recorded. A blank date sets no limit on that side.

items.label: Status
items.description: Worked out for today's date in the laboratory's time zone. Current: today is within the validity dates (both dates count as valid). Not yet valid: Valid from is later than today. Expired: Valid until is earlier than today.

items.label: Add certificate
items.description: Admin role only. Opens the form to record another certificate. A laboratory can list at most 50.

items.label: Remove
items.description: Admin role only. Asks for confirmation, then removes the certificate from the list. The audit history keeps what the certificate held. If the certificate changed after you opened this page, the removal is refused; reload and try again.

sections.title: Optional modules
paragraphs: Parts of the application the laboratory switches on. A module that is off shows no page, menu entry or link anywhere, and its records are kept. Only the admin role turns a module on or off, with a reason.

items.label: Module
items.description: The module's name, for example Nonconformance and corrective action.

items.label: What it adds
items.description: What the module adds to the application.

items.label: Status
items.description: On or Off for the whole laboratory. A module never switched is Off.

items.label: Turn on / Turn off
items.description: Admin role only. Opens the form to switch the module, with a reason (see Turn a module on or off).

sections.title: History
paragraphs: Every change is audited with the administrator, the time and the values before and after. Module switches and contact changes also keep the reason given.

items.label: History
items.description: The newest 20 profile changes, contact changes and module switches together, shown oldest first: Lab profile changed (address or contact details), Lab logo changed, Lab logo removed, Lab certificate added, changed or removed with the certificate's authority and number, Lab contact changed with the contact it changed and the reason, and Module enabled or Module disabled with the module's name and the reason, each with its time and the administrator who made it.
